title: В + prepositional: In May, last year

blocks.text: В + Prepositional indicates the year or the month in which an event takes place.

items: at the beginning of the century

items.head: В + Prepositional is used:
points: to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) in which an event takes place
to indicate the beginning, the middle, the end or any other phase of a period in which an event takes place

items.text: Units larger than a week (month, year) take „В + Loc.“

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 73 and 75. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.
